periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Downward diagonal slope relative to the horizontal axis of the head.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated ovoid shape with a high length-to-width ratio.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Visible downward tapering at the anterior-inferior boundary of the patch.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Wide, shallow U-shaped curve at the posterior margin along the dorsal spine.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: The dark band covers approximately 25-30% of the visible torso length at the lateral flank.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: The ears are separated by a wide white furred region equivalent to the cranial width.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: The superior borders of the pinnae exhibit smooth, convex rounding.

other_distinctive_markers: Extensive brownish-red pigmentation or staining present on the white fur of the posterior dorsal and lateral regions.
